postings.title: Senior Accountant
postings.text:
ABOUT THRIVE MARKET

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

Thrive Market is looking for a Senior Accountant to join our growing, fully remote Accounting team. This is an excellent opportunity to professionally develop within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. The candidate is responsible for maintaining timely, accurate financial records and performing other day-to-day activities and ad hoc projects on the accounting team. The position will assume ownership of a wide range of account reconciliations, financial closing activities, and other projects to support our financial close process. The candidate for the Senior Accountant position must have an advanced understanding of financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow) and how they relate to one another. Candidates must also have a working knowledge of US GAAP and internal controls.

The ideal candidate is self-motivated, has a keen eye for detail, and works independently and reliably with team members throughout various levels of the company. This role will report to the Accounting Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Responsible for monthly financial closing activities, procedures, journal entries, and account reconciliations

• Support month-end and year-end close activities

• Monitor and review financial activity , as well as assist with flux analysis, to help ensure transactions are recorded timely and accurately

• Partner with internal teams and external business contacts to support accurate and timely financial processes

• Assist with the annual financial audit and related documentation requests

• Take on ad-hoc accounting projects and other duties as needed to support the Accounting and Finance team

• Utilize accounting systems and tools to process, record, and maintain financial transactions

QUALIFICATIONS

• 3–5 years in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related analytical field

• Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field

• Experience in e-commerce, retail, or CPG is a plus

• Advanced Excel skills and comfort with complex financial modeling

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to manipulate and interpret large data sets to draw actionable insights

• Experience with SQL or BI tools (Domo, Tableau, etc.) strongly preferred

• Experience with ERP/planning/forecasting/reporting tools (NetSuite, Adaptive, etc.) strongly preferred

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally

• Highly organized with a strong attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

REQUIREMENT

• 2+ years relevant accounting experience, Big 4 experience +CPA preferred

• Strong accounting knowledge and understanding of GAAP

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite with an emphasis on Excel

• Polished professional communication skills

• Effective organizational and time management skills

• Ability to work independently or as a team member in a fully remote environment

• Have an interest in learning and growing within an accounting department

• NetSuite & Claude experience is a plus

BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life and disability)

• Competitive salary (DOE) + equity

• 401k plan

• 9 Observed Holidays

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Subsidized ClassPass Membership with access to fitness classes and wellness and beauty experiences

• Ability to work in our beautiful office in Playa Vista

• Free Thrive Market membership with exclusive employee discount

• Coverage for Life Coaching & Therapy Sessions on our holistic mental health and well-being platform

We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.

At Thrive Market, we believe in building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic culture. If you are excited about this role along with our mission and values, we encourage you to apply.

Thrive Market is an EEO/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ employer

At Thrive Market, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workplace that is representative, at all job levels, of the members we serve and the communities we operate in. We’re proud to be an inclusive company and an Equal Opportunity Employer and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. If you’re thinking about joining our team, we expect that you would agree!

Employment with Thrive Market requires that employees be based in the United States. This is a condition of employment and must be maintained throughout the duration of employment.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please email us at eeo@thrivemarket.com and we’ll be happy to assist you.

Ensure your Thrive Market job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Thrive Market never seeks payment from job applicants. Thrive Market recruiters will only reach out to applicants from an @thrivemarket.com email address. For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at www.thrivemarket.com.

JOB INFORMATION

• Compensation Description - The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $100,000/Per Year.

• Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and geographic location.

• Total Compensation includes Base Salary, Stock Options, Health & Wellness Benefits, Flexible PTO, and more!

• This position requires traveling to our HQ office in Los Angeles, California, twice a year for all-company summits; once in the summer and once in the winter.
